top_signals.title: Global Bond Rout Brings Highest US 30-Year Yield Since 2004
top_signals.summary: Yields on the US’s longest-dated bonds climbed to the highest level in more than two decades, the latest milestone in a global selloff driven by inflation fears and concern about government debt burdens.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
